name: Vaidyaratnam Oushadhasala
summary: Vaidyaratnam Oushadhasala is the Ayurveda house of the Thaikkattu Mooss family of Ashtavaidyas at Thaikkattussery, near Thrissur, established in 1941. The group makes classical medicines and runs more than 25 hospitals and clinics; the family's Ayurveda museum stands nearby.
highlights: More than 25 hospitals and clinics, and three manufacturing units
Vaidyaratnam Ayurveda Museum, opened in 2013 in the family mana, per Kerala Tourism
